fonts.note: System Helvetica stack verbatim from the real site; no webfont shipped. Mono used for eyebrows, step numbers, footer column headings and code.

radii.rule: Constraint D8: cards keep a >=1px --line border and radius <= 18px.

signatures.markDraw: hero <mark>::before draws the lime highlighter once: scaleY(0->1) from left bottom, inset 62% 0 8% 0, 700ms drawIn easing, 250ms delay
signatures.cardLift: .game:hover translateY(-4px) scale(1.03) on spring easing + box-shadow 6px 8px 0 var(--lime) + border-color var(--ink)
signatures.btnHover: solid buttons go --solid-hover with 0 0 0 3px var(--lime) ring; active translateY(1px)

rules: One-shot motion only: entrance animations run once with both fill; nothing loops.
Hover replies are interaction-triggered, never idle animation.
Every animation has a prefers-reduced-motion: reduce guard that disables it while keeping artwork fully visible.
motion.reducedMotion: Global kill in index.css (0.01ms durations, 1 iteration) plus per-effect guards on .hero mark::before, .game, and all .sngw-* animations.

halloween.flag: HALLOWEEN = true in src/components/startng-whimsy/Halloween.jsx (flip to false to remove the layer)
halloween.pumpkinScope: --sngw-pumpkin defined only on .sngw-hw; consumed only by .sngw-fill-pumpkin; never used on UI chrome, text, or tokens
halloween.placement: Cobweb top-left of hero; two bats absolute in hero; pumpkin near the see-all row (swaps in for the PixelTrail doodles); ghost stays inline on all screens
halloween.smallScreens: Hero .sngw-cobweb and .sngw-bat plus .see-all .sngw-pumpkin hide at <=640px; the inline ghost remains
halloween.provenance: Addition by this rebuild; all non-pumpkin colour comes from the inherited page tokens
